theme: Kaash mein atak kar present kho dena

main_text: Main roz shaam usi khidki par baitha raha, / jahan se maine woh suraj doobte dekha tha. / Har baar socha — kaash woh thoda aur ruk jaata, / kaash us din maine kuch aur keh diya hota. / Aur isi "kaash" mein, chupchaap, / Maa ki di hui chai thandi hoti rahi, / doston ke phone bajte-bajte chup ho gaye, / aur poori raat, taare mera intezaar karte rahe.

theme: Hamesha sabke liye strong aur samajhdar bane rehne ki thakawat

main_text: हँसौं तो दुःख ना बीसरै रोवौं बल घटि जाय। / मनहीँ माहिँ बिसूरना ज्यौं घुन काठहिँ खाय॥४२॥ || Sabko lagta hai tum sab sambhal loge, / isliye koi haal bhi nahi poochhta. / Khaali office aur screen ki roshni, / baitha hai ek thaka hua insaan. / Hamesha mazboot dikhne ki zidd, / andar se khokhla karti rehti hai. / Kya kabhi thak kar rukne ka haq milega?

author: Mool rachna
verification: Mool rachna, verification ki zaroorat nahi
main_text: Purani photo mein dekha khud ko, / Ek baccha jo befikr hansta tha. / Na kal ki koi chinta thi tab, / Na kagaz ke tukdon ka hisaab. / Shaam hote hi doston ke saath, / Har chhoti baat par muskurana. / Ab shaam bhi dhal jaati hai, / Kaam ke kagazon ke beech. / Kaash laut aayein woh din, / Jahan jeena kitna aasan tha.

theme: Financial responsibilities aur apne sapne
author: Mool rachna
verification: Mool rachna, verification ki zaroorat nahi
main_text: Kagaz par hisaab likhte hain, / Apne armaan mitate hain. / Ghar ke kharch aur karz ke beech, / Kahin woh bachpan kho gaya hai. / Ab toh bas subah hoti hai, / Raat ko thakaan utarti hai. / Woh purana sheher kahin chhoot gaya, / Jahan udne ke liye pankh kaafi the.
